segments.name: Americas
products: Flame detectors and open-path infrared gas detectors
segments.description: Sells safety products including detection instruments, fire service equipment and industrial PPE to distributors and end-users in the Americas.
segments.evidence: Our primary breathing apparatus product in the Americas segment, the MSA G1 SCBA, is a platform that offers many differentiated features.

segments.name: International
products: Flame detectors and open-path infrared gas detectors
segments.description: Sells safety products including detection instruments, fire service equipment and industrial PPE through direct and indirect channels outside the Americas.
segments.evidence: The MSA M1 SCBA, which is our primary breathing apparatus product in the International segment, represents the most advanced and ergonomic SCBA that we have launched in the International markets.

revenueModel.text: MSA is paid by distributors and end-user customers for its safety products, solutions and related services, with the Americas selling mostly through distribution and the International segment using both indirect and direct channels.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers generally fall into two categories: distributors and end-user customers.
